name: Preparation of S355 tensile test pieces
description: Machining of flat tensile test pieces (E6x20x60) out of the S355 steel sheet, in rolling direction (Zx), transverse (Zy) and diagonal (Zd). Illustrative: process class and participants are assumed.
source: Illustrative example, partly synthetic: the BAM dataset (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6778336, CC-BY-4.0) states only that the test pieces were taken from the S355 sheet in rolling direction; the process class and its participants are assumed.
